reversible_chemistry.represents: Ester hydrolysis is an equilibrium reaction: EGDA <-> EGMA <-> EG with equilibrium constants K1, K2 and thermodynamically consistent reverse rates.
reversible_chemistry.when_true: Both steps carry reverse rates; K1_ref and K2_ref are estimated parameters; net rates vanish exactly at the coupled-equilibrium composition (microscopic reversibility).
reversible_chemistry.when_false: Irreversible A -> B -> C kinetics.  The K parameters do not exist in the truth or in any candidate model, conversion is monotone to completion, and the parameter vector drops to four.

temperature_dependent_kinetics.represents: Arrhenius temperature dependence of the two rate constants, k_i(T) = k_i_ref exp[-(Ea_i/R)(1/T - 1/T_ref)].
temperature_dependent_kinetics.when_true: Ea1 and Ea2 act on the rates and are estimated; temperature is an informative design dimension.
temperature_dependent_kinetics.when_false: Ea = 0 is applied in the forward model and Ea1/Ea2 are held FIXED in every parameter space: k(T) = k_ref, isothermal kinetics, and the temperature axis carries no kinetic information.

temperature_dependent_equilibrium.represents: van 't Hoff temperature dependence of the two equilibrium constants, K_i(T) = K_i_ref exp[-(dH_i/R)(1/T - 1/T_ref)].
temperature_dependent_equilibrium.when_true: The literature dH values shift the equilibrium with temperature (they are fixed, not estimated - see layer1_bridge).
temperature_dependent_equilibrium.when_false: dH = 0: K(T) = K_ref, a temperature-independent equilibrium.

nonideal_acid_activity.represents: Pitzer activity coefficients for the catalytic proton in a concentrated aqueous sulfate medium.
nonideal_acid_activity.when_true: The catalytic activity a_H+ = gamma * [H+] uses the Pitzer model, so rate constants respond to ionic strength as well as to acid concentration.
nonideal_acid_activity.when_false: Dilute-solution ideality, gamma = 1: activity equals concentration and the acid axis acts purely through [H+].

acid_speciation_equilibrium.represents: Second dissociation of sulfuric acid, HSO4- <-> H+ + SO4(2-), solved as an equilibrium rather than assumed complete.
acid_speciation_equilibrium.when_true: [H+] is obtained from the Ka2 equilibrium at the local temperature, so it is a nonlinear function of total sulfate.
acid_speciation_equilibrium.when_false: Stoichiometric protons: [H+] = n_eff * [H2SO4], independent of temperature and of the sulfate equilibrium.

temperature_dependent_ka2.represents: Temperature dependence of Ka2, which moves by orders of magnitude over the 40-160 C window.
temperature_dependent_ka2.when_true: Ka2(T) is evaluated at the LOCAL temperature - reactor temperature in the reactor, line temperature in the cooled transfer line.
temperature_dependent_ka2.when_false: Ka2 is held at its reference-temperature value everywhere.

packed_bed_reactor.represents: Inert random packing (spherical beads, void fraction eps) in the tubular reactor.
packed_bed_reactor.when_true: Liquid holdup is eps * V, so tau shrinks by eps and the interstitial velocity rises by 1/eps; the bed's mechanical dispersion replaces molecular diffusion in the plug-flow criterion, which is what makes the reactor admissible at the design flows.
packed_bed_reactor.when_false: An OPEN tube: eps = 1, tau = V/Q, and radial mixing is molecular only.  At the declared flows this is a radially segregated laminar tube, so `reactor_validity_enforcement` will refuse it (see the guidance the validity check prints).

reactor_validity_enforcement.represents: Whether the plug-flow criterion is a CONSTRAINT or a comment.
reactor_validity_enforcement.when_true: The reactor in use is checked at EVERY permitted flow and an inadmissible reactor stops the run (VALIDITY policy 'error'), with guidance on which bound to change.
reactor_validity_enforcement.when_false: The check still runs and is still archived, but never blocks (policy 'ignore') - a deliberate non-ideal study, recorded as one.

axial_dispersion_criterion.represents: The Bodenstein criterion Bo = uL/D_ax >= 100 (the classical '< 1 % deviation from plug flow' boundary), in addition to the radial-mixing criterion.
axial_dispersion_criterion.when_true: Both criteria must hold.  For an open tube they are one criterion in disguise (Bo = 48/(t_rad/tau)); for a packed bed the axial one becomes the bed aspect ratio requirement.
axial_dispersion_criterion.when_false: Only the radial-mixing ratio decides; Bo is computed and archived but does not enter the verdict - the historical behaviour.  (With reactor_validity_enforcement off this still changes the RECORDED verdict, it just stops being a blocking constraint.)

geometry_optimization.represents: Treating the reactor geometry itself as a design variable ('I am building a reactor for this chemistry') instead of a given ('I have this reactor').
geometry_optimization.when_true: The reactor is sized once from the PRIOR before round 1, under information minus resource cost with plug-flow feasibility enforced over the whole flow envelope; blind scoring still happens in the declared reference reactor.
geometry_optimization.when_false: The declared GEOMETRY is used unchanged for every campaign - the conservative default, and the question the published benchmark answered before geometry became a design variable.

transfer_line.represents: The physical path from the sampling capillary orifice to the NMR flow cell: a finite volume with a finite residence time.
transfer_line.when_true: Sampling is not instantaneous; the composition reaching the cell differs from the composition at z.  Enables the four effects below.
transfer_line.when_false: Identity transform: the NMR sees exactly the reactor composition at the sampled position.

transfer_line_reaction.represents: Continued reaction in the sample between withdrawal and detection.
transfer_line_reaction.when_true: Each residence-time quadrature node is propagated with the true kinetics for its own transit time, so the measurement is of an OLDER state than the sampling position.
transfer_line_reaction.when_false: The sample is frozen at withdrawal: transport delays the sample but does not change it.

transfer_line_temperature_correction.represents: The line is COOLED before the flow cell, so post-sampling reaction runs at the line temperature and not at the reactor temperature.
transfer_line_temperature_correction.when_true: T_line_C is commanded (25 C): a sample leaving a 160 C reactor barely reacts on the way, and the catalytic [H+] is re-solved at the LINE temperature.  Both truth and inference use the commanded value, which is public knowledge.
transfer_line_temperature_correction.when_false: T_line = T_reactor, the legacy assumption: the sample keeps reacting at full reactor temperature all the way to the cell, which over-states the in-line conversion badly at high T.

transfer_line_rtd_dispersion.represents: Residence-time distribution of the line (tanks-in-series / gamma) rather than a single delay.
transfer_line_rtd_dispersion.when_true: The cell sees a WEIGHTED MIXTURE of ages, so the measurement is smeared as well as delayed.
transfer_line_rtd_dispersion.when_false: Plug (delta) RTD: one sharp delay, the legacy transfer_time_s limit.

transfer_line_carryover.represents: Incomplete flushing after the capillary moves: the line still holds part of the previous sample.
transfer_line_carryover.when_true: An exponential flushing model mixes old and new sample, so a measurement depends on the PREVIOUS sampling position.
transfer_line_carryover.when_false: Every acquisition sees only its own sample.

transfer_correction_in_inference.represents: Whether the CONTROLLER corrects its predictions for the transfer delay it commanded.
transfer_correction_in_inference.when_true: The observation operator adds the nominal tau(z) = V(z)/Q_sample at the commanded line temperature, from COMMANDED quantities only - never the truth's RTD or carryover, which stay unmodelled.
transfer_correction_in_inference.when_false: The controller compares the kinetic model against the reactor state as if the line did not exist - the F-uncorr ablation.

nmr_fid_engine.represents: Time-domain simulation: complex FID -> T2* decay -> receiver noise -> phase -> FFT, the honest model of the instrument.
nmr_fid_engine.when_true: The acquisition time, dwell, point count and zero filling are all physical and affect the spectrum; slower.
nmr_fid_engine.when_false: The ANALYTIC engine builds the frequency-domain lineshape directly.  It has no acquisition time at all (the acquisition settings then affect only the campaign clock), and it is what makes 40-seed Monte Carlo affordable.

nmr_white_noise.represents: Additive receiver noise on the spectrum.
nmr_white_noise.when_true: Each acquisition carries independent Gaussian noise of noise_sigma/sqrt(n_scans) per point.
nmr_white_noise.when_false: A noiseless spectrum: repeated acquisitions of one composition are bit-identical, and quantification error comes only from lineshape and overlap.

nmr_correlated_noise.represents: Colour (AR(1) correlation) in that noise, which real receiver and processing chains have and a white-noise fitter does not model.
nmr_correlated_noise.when_true: Neighbouring spectral points are correlated, so the fitted covariance - derived under a white-noise assumption - understates the true parameter uncertainty.
nmr_correlated_noise.when_false: White noise: the fitter's noise assumption is exactly right.

nmr_line_broadening.represents: Acquisition-to-acquisition variation in linewidth (shim drift, temperature, flow).
nmr_line_broadening.when_true: Each acquisition draws a lognormal linewidth factor; the fitter must estimate it.
nmr_line_broadening.when_false: Every acquisition has exactly the nominal linewidth, so the fitter has one fewer nuisance to estimate.

nmr_baseline_distortion.represents: Baseline offset, curvature and a cubic term that the fitter's quadratic baseline model cannot represent.
nmr_baseline_distortion.when_true: A polynomial background is added; the cubic part is deliberately outside the fitter's model, so baseline error is not fully removable.
nmr_baseline_distortion.when_false: A flat, zero baseline: whatever the fitter cannot remove is not there in the first place.

nmr_chemical_shift_drift.represents: Reference drift, per-group shift jitter, and a per-campaign STATIC shift miscalibration of the instrument.
nmr_chemical_shift_drift.when_true: Peak positions move between acquisitions and are systematically off from the database, which matters in the 7 Hz EGDA/EGMA acetyl overlap where a sub-Hz shift reapportions area between species.
nmr_chemical_shift_drift.when_false: Every resonance sits exactly at its database shift, so the overlap is apportioned by area alone.

nmr_phase_error.represents: Zero-order phase error, which mixes dispersion lineshape into the absorption spectrum.
nmr_phase_error.when_true: A random phase per acquisition; the fitter estimates it within a bounded window.
nmr_phase_error.when_false: Perfectly phased spectra: pure absorption lineshape, no dispersion component to fit.

nmr_gain_drift.when_true: A multiplicative factor scales EVERY species coherently, which is why it enters the covariance as a rank-one correlated term rather than a diagonal one.
nmr_gain_drift.when_false: Constant, exactly calibrated receiver gain - no coherent scaling term in the covariance.

nmr_lineshape_mismatch.represents: TRUTH-MODEL MISMATCH (anti-inverse-crime): the true lineshape is pseudo-Voigt and the true 3J differs from the fitter's database, so the fitter never fits its own exact physics.
nmr_lineshape_mismatch.when_true: The truth deviates from the fitting model in ways the fitter does not know, which is what makes synthetic validation meaningful.
nmr_lineshape_mismatch.when_false: Pure Lorentzian truth with the database J: the fitter's model is EXACTLY correct - an inverse crime, useful only as a control.

nmr_response_calibration.represents: Pre-campaign per-species response calibration against prepared standards - the real Fourier-80 workflow.
nmr_response_calibration.when_true: Systematic response/lineshape bias is absorbed into measured public factors, and the residual error model (bias, correlation, variance) is regressed on those standards.
nmr_response_calibration.when_false: Nominal response factors are assumed: any true response error passes straight into the quantified concentrations uncorrected.

overlap_correlated_errors.represents: Correlated quantification error between species whose resonances overlap (EGDA/EGMA acetyl).
overlap_correlated_errors.when_true: The assumed direct-observation covariance carries rho_overlap between the overlapping pair, matching what the spectral fit produces naturally through its Jacobian.
overlap_correlated_errors.when_false: Independent per-species errors: a strictly diagonal covariance, as if the resonances did not overlap.

quantification_uncertainty.represents: The part of the measurement error that a single spectrum's Jacobian cannot see: reproducibility floors, coherent gain, shift-jitter propagation and the empirically calibrated residual covariance.
quantification_uncertainty.when_true: Sigma_y = within-spectrum fit covariance + floor + rank-one gain term + shift-jitter propagation + the empirical model measured on standards.  This is the covariance the design layer also uses.
quantification_uncertainty.when_false: Sigma_y is the pure within-spectrum statistical covariance.  Optimistic by construction - useful for isolating how much of the reported uncertainty comes from the error model rather than the spectra.

instrument_faults.represents: Gross, QC-DETECTABLE hardware failures: lost lock, a gas bubble in the flow cell, a failed shim.
instrument_faults.when_true: A fraction of acquisitions carry a structured artifact no lineshape model can fit, so the deconvolution raises FAIL and the QC gate rejects them before assimilation.
instrument_faults.when_false: The only QC failures are genuine spectral-fit failures on hard compositions - which still occur, and are still caught.

measurement_outliers.represents: UNDETECTABLE quantification outliers: a mis-apportioned overlapped integral gives a concentration wrong by many claimed sigmas while the spectral residual stays normal.
measurement_outliers.when_true: Heavy-tailed quantification error that the QC gate cannot see, testing the robustness of the INFERENCE rather than of the gate.
measurement_outliers.when_false: Quantification error stays within its calibrated distribution - no heavy tail beyond the reported sigma.

qc_rejection.represents: The quality-control gate between the spectrometer and the kinetic posterior.
qc_rejection.when_true: A spectrum with FAIL flags is NEVER assimilated; persistent failure pauses the campaign instead of designing new chemistry on corrupted data.
qc_rejection.when_false: Every quantified spectrum is assimilated, flags and all - the posterior sees whatever the instrument produced.

qc_retry_on_failure.represents: Re-acquiring a position whose spectrum failed QC.
qc_retry_on_failure.when_true: Up to max_retries reacquisitions per failing position, metered as instrument time; a transient fault costs time, not data.
qc_retry_on_failure.when_false: A failing position is dropped immediately - no second attempt, and no reacquisition time is spent.

continuous_design_space.represents: Whether operating conditions are chosen from a factorial GRID or anywhere inside the declared bounds.
continuous_design_space.when_true: The optimizer may propose any point inside continuous_bounds, SNAPPED to the resolution the hardware can command and accepted only when it strictly beats the best grid point - so it can never be worse than the grid.
continuous_design_space.when_false: The classical discrete factorial grid only - conditions are chosen from declared levels and nowhere else.

spatial_optimization.represents: Choosing WHERE along the reactor to sample, rather than sampling equally spaced ports.
spatial_optimization.when_true: Positions are selected by incremental D-optimality on the current information landscape.
spatial_optimization.when_false: Fixed, equally spaced axial positions - the classical profile, identical in every round.

adaptive_single_measurement.represents: Truly sequential axial sampling: choose z, acquire ONE spectrum, update the full posterior, then choose the next z.
adaptive_single_measurement.when_true: The realized measurement changes the next position.  Note the consequence for QC: a round contains a single acquisition, so a per-round rejection FRACTION is meaningless and the gate's persistence rules (consecutive / rolling window) are what detect a broken instrument.
adaptive_single_measurement.when_false: Positions for a round are chosen as a BATCH before any of them is measured.

bayesian_model_discrimination.represents: Designing experiments to tell candidate MODELS apart, not only to sharpen parameters.
bayesian_model_discrimination.when_true: The acquisition adds a model-discrimination EIG term, up-weighted while the ensemble is undecided.
bayesian_model_discrimination.when_false: Pure parameter-information design; model probabilities are still tracked but never steer an experiment.

model_inadequacy_governor.represents: The lack-of-fit governor that decides whether the residuals mean 'parameters still uncertain' or 'model structurally wrong'.
model_inadequacy_governor.when_true: Every round is tested; a MODEL_INADEQUATE verdict stops the controller exploiting a model it no longer trusts.
model_inadequacy_governor.when_false: The controller always exploits the current best model - the F-noGovernor ablation.

governor_dispersion_robust.represents: Whether the governor's lack-of-fit decision is invariant to a uniform mis-scaling of the measurement covariance.
governor_dispersion_robust.when_true: The realized dispersion phi = r'r/dof is estimated and used to standardize the STRUCTURAL components, and the absolute chi2 magnitude leaves the decision set under a declared measurement systematic - because its power against a mis-scaled Sigma_y grows without bound in n.  The gross-misfit override still applies.
governor_dispersion_robust.when_false: The historical behaviour: chi2 magnitude decides, and the structural nulls assume the claimed Sigma_y is exactly right.

identifiability_screen.represents: A pre-campaign screen that holds parameters the declared design space cannot identify at their literature values.
identifiability_screen.when_true: Unidentifiable parameters are fixed rather than fitted, so their unbounded confidence intervals do not contaminate the D-optimal criterion.
identifiability_screen.when_false: Every parameter is estimated regardless of whether the design space can excite it, unbounded intervals included.

resource_accounting.represents: Metering of campaign time, material, waste, energy and capillary travel from an auditable event log.
resource_accounting.when_true: Every physical action is logged and totalled; convergence can be reported per unit resource, not only per round.
resource_accounting.when_false: Resources are not metered (all totals zero); only round counts are comparable.

resource_aware_design.represents: Letting the design objective trade information against resource cost (the lambda weights).
resource_aware_design.when_true: The acquisition maximizes information MINUS lambda-weighted cost, so a marginally more informative but far more expensive experiment loses.
resource_aware_design.when_false: Pure information maximization: lambda = 0, cost is metered and reported but never influences a decision.

acquisition_time_accounting.represents: Deriving the per-spectrum clock from the acquisition settings: t = overhead + n_scans x (recycle + acquisition).
acquisition_time_accounting.when_true: n_scans, the recycle delay and the acquisition time move the campaign clock as they physically must - the spectrometer settings and the campaign clock are ONE model.
acquisition_time_accounting.when_false: A LEGACY fixed per-spectrum duration, independent of the acquisition settings.  Provided only to reproduce archives made before the decomposition existed.

nmr_response_calibration.when_false: Nominal response factors are assumed: any true response error passes straight into the quantified concentrations uncorrected.

overlap_correlated_errors.represents: Correlated quantification error between species whose resonances overlap (EGDA/EGMA acetyl).
overlap_correlated_errors.when_true: The assumed direct-observation covariance carries rho_overlap between the overlapping pair, matching what the spectral fit produces naturally through its Jacobian.
overlap_correlated_errors.when_false: Independent per-species errors: a strictly diagonal covariance, as if the resonances did not overlap.

quantification_uncertainty.represents: The part of the measurement error that a single spectrum's Jacobian cannot see: reproducibility floors, coherent gain, shift-jitter propagation and the empirically calibrated residual covariance.
quantification_uncertainty.when_true: Sigma_y = within-spectrum fit covariance + floor + rank-one gain term + shift-jitter propagation + the empirical model measured on standards.  This is the covariance the design layer also uses.
quantification_uncertainty.when_false: Sigma_y is the pure within-spectrum statistical covariance.  Optimistic by construction - useful for isolating how much of the reported uncertainty comes from the error model rather than the spectra.

instrument_faults.represents: Gross, QC-DETECTABLE hardware failures: lost lock, a gas bubble in the flow cell, a failed shim.
instrument_faults.when_true: A fraction of acquisitions carry a structured artifact no lineshape model can fit, so the deconvolution raises FAIL and the QC gate rejects them before assimilation.
instrument_faults.when_false: The only QC failures are genuine spectral-fit failures on hard compositions - which still occur, and are still caught.

measurement_outliers.represents: UNDETECTABLE quantification outliers: a mis-apportioned overlapped integral gives a concentration wrong by many claimed sigmas while the spectral residual stays normal.
measurement_outliers.when_true: Heavy-tailed quantification error that the QC gate cannot see, testing the robustness of the INFERENCE rather than of the gate.
measurement_outliers.when_false: Quantification error stays within its calibrated distribution - no heavy tail beyond the reported sigma.

qc_rejection.represents: The quality-control gate between the spectrometer and the kinetic posterior.
qc_rejection.when_true: A spectrum with FAIL flags is NEVER assimilated; persistent failure pauses the campaign instead of designing new chemistry on corrupted data.
qc_rejection.when_false: Every quantified spectrum is assimilated, flags and all - the posterior sees whatever the instrument produced.

qc_retry_on_failure.represents: Re-acquiring a position whose spectrum failed QC.
qc_retry_on_failure.when_true: Up to max_retries reacquisitions per failing position, metered as instrument time; a transient fault costs time, not data.
qc_retry_on_failure.when_false: A failing position is dropped immediately - no second attempt, and no reacquisition time is spent.

continuous_design_space.represents: Whether operating conditions are chosen from a factorial GRID or anywhere inside the declared bounds.
continuous_design_space.when_true: The optimizer may propose any point inside continuous_bounds, SNAPPED to the resolution the hardware can command and accepted only when it strictly beats the best grid point - so it can never be worse than the grid.
continuous_design_space.when_false: The classical discrete factorial grid only - conditions are chosen from declared levels and nowhere else.

spatial_optimization.represents: Choosing WHERE along the reactor to sample, rather than sampling equally spaced ports.
spatial_optimization.when_true: Positions are selected by incremental D-optimality on the current information landscape.
spatial_optimization.when_false: Fixed, equally spaced axial positions - the classical profile, identical in every round.

adaptive_single_measurement.represents: Truly sequential axial sampling: choose z, acquire ONE spectrum, update the full posterior, then choose the next z.
adaptive_single_measurement.when_true: The realized measurement changes the next position.  Note the consequence for QC: a round contains a single acquisition, so a per-round rejection FRACTION is meaningless and the gate's persistence rules (consecutive / rolling window) are what detect a broken instrument.
adaptive_single_measurement.when_false: Positions for a round are chosen as a BATCH before any of them is measured.

bayesian_model_discrimination.represents: Designing experiments to tell candidate MODELS apart, not only to sharpen parameters.
bayesian_model_discrimination.when_true: The acquisition adds a model-discrimination EIG term, up-weighted while the ensemble is undecided.
bayesian_model_discrimination.when_false: Pure parameter-information design; model probabilities are still tracked but never steer an experiment.

model_inadequacy_governor.represents: The lack-of-fit governor that decides whether the residuals mean 'parameters still uncertain' or 'model structurally wrong'.
model_inadequacy_governor.when_true: Every round is tested; a MODEL_INADEQUATE verdict stops the controller exploiting a model it no longer trusts.
model_inadequacy_governor.when_false: The controller always exploits the current best model - the F-noGovernor ablation.

governor_dispersion_robust.represents: Whether the governor's lack-of-fit decision is invariant to a uniform mis-scaling of the measurement covariance.
governor_dispersion_robust.when_true: The realized dispersion phi = r'r/dof is estimated and used to standardize the STRUCTURAL components, and the absolute chi2 magnitude leaves the decision set under a declared measurement systematic - because its power against a mis-scaled Sigma_y grows without bound in n.  The gross-misfit override still applies.
governor_dispersion_robust.when_false: The historical behaviour: chi2 magnitude decides, and the structural nulls assume the claimed Sigma_y is exactly right.

identifiability_screen.represents: A pre-campaign screen that holds parameters the declared design space cannot identify at their literature values.
identifiability_screen.when_true: Unidentifiable parameters are fixed rather than fitted, so their unbounded confidence intervals do not contaminate the D-optimal criterion.
identifiability_screen.when_false: Every parameter is estimated regardless of whether the design space can excite it, unbounded intervals included.

resource_accounting.represents: Metering of campaign time, material, waste, energy and capillary travel from an auditable event log.
resource_accounting.when_true: Every physical action is logged and totalled; convergence can be reported per unit resource, not only per round.
resource_accounting.when_false: Resources are not metered (all totals zero); only round counts are comparable.

resource_aware_design.represents: Letting the design objective trade information against resource cost (the lambda weights).
resource_aware_design.when_true: The acquisition maximizes information MINUS lambda-weighted cost, so a marginally more informative but far more expensive experiment loses.
resource_aware_design.when_false: Pure information maximization: lambda = 0, cost is metered and reported but never influences a decision.

acquisition_time_accounting.represents: Deriving the per-spectrum clock from the acquisition settings: t = overhead + n_scans x (recycle + acquisition).
acquisition_time_accounting.when_true: n_scans, the recycle delay and the acquisition time move the campaign clock as they physically must - the spectrometer settings and the campaign clock are ONE model.
acquisition_time_accounting.when_false: A LEGACY fixed per-spectrum duration, independent of the acquisition settings.  Provided only to reproduce archives made before the decomposition existed.

systematic_allowance_derivation.source: derived from control data under the current configuration
